title: Spectrum SBSCBC 40V Standard Battery Charger (0.5A)
description: Keep Your Spectrum Battery Ready - Standard 40V Charger The Spectrum SBSCBC is the no-fuss standard charger for all compatible Spectrum 40V lithium-ion batteries. Plug in after a session, leave it overnight, and your battery will be fully replenished and ready to go again by morning. With a steady 0.5A output at 40V, the SBSCBC charges at a gentle, battery-friendly rate - ideal if your toolkit runs on a single battery that you want to look after for the long term. Slow overnight charging is widely regarded as the kindest charge cycle for lithium-ion longevity. The charger is compact at just 8x9x12cm and weighs under 200g, so it tucks away neatly in a drawer, shed shelf, or toolbox. Simple LED indication lets you know when charging is underway and when it's complete. If faster charging is a priority, consider upgrading to the Spectrum SBSCSC Fast Charger (2A), which cuts charge time to a quarter of the standard rate.
